title: Tinybird Forward
tagline: Tinybird's CLI-first platform: file-based schema + auto-planned rebuilds.
description: Tinybird Forward — the `tb` CLI backed by a Tinybird Local Docker container that bundles ClickHouse. Schema lives in .datasource files; `tb deploy` detects sort-key changes that can't be applied via ALTER and rewrites + backfills automatically. Measures whether the agent can drive the Forward workflow end-to-end for a destructive ORDER BY change.
installScript: set -e && (apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg && install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/debian/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg && echo 'deb [arch='"$(dpkg --print-architecture)"' signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/debian bookworm stable' > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends docker-ce-cli && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*) && curl -fsSL https://tinybird.co | sh && ln -sf /root/.local/bin/tb /usr/local/bin/tb
